summary: John's maternal 5th great-grandmother; mother of Carmine Fiorillo. Replaces the tree's 'Maria Morrello'.
bio:
Round 3 found her in Carmine's death act (San Mango Morti 1860 act 30); reading Marrelli/Morelli. The tree instead gives Carmine's mother as 'Maria Morrello' (1786-1846) with a deep Morrello/Guercio/Chiarello pedigree - same surname family possibly, different given name. Whether Vittoria and the tree's Maria are the same woman is unresolved.

Vittoria Marrello was a real person, but she was the wife of Francesco Gabriele Fiorillo, not of Domenico. Her sons Gabriele (d. 1839, aged 7), Angelo (c.1824-1912) and Lorenzo (c.1835-1915) are all recorded as children of Francesco Fiorillo and Vittoria Marrello ([R4-S2], [R4-S3]). Carmine's own 1840 marriage, made during his mother's lifetime, names her as Maria Marrelli ([R4-S1]). The 1860 death act and burial ([R4-S4]) evidently substituted the aunt's name. Recommendation: detach Vittoria from John's line and use Maria Marrello (I282824815353) as Carmine's mother.
